environment.description: Same Lambda function deployed on AWS Lambda with a custom container image (ECR-hosted) based on public.ecr.aws/lambda/python:3.11. The Dockerfile applies a hardened runtime configuration: capabilities are explicitly dropped via a custom bootstrap wrapper that invokes the runtime interface client under a restricted seccomp profile (embedded as /opt/seccomp-policy.json). The profile denies the openat/openat2 syscalls when the resolved path (after kernel-level symlink resolution) references any file outside /tmp/asset_cache or /var/task or /opt. Additionally, CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN are dropped from the effective/permitted capability sets via capsh in the entrypoint script. The container runs with read-only root filesystem (--read-only flag in the container config), meaning /var/runtime, /etc, /proc (partially), and all paths outside /tmp are immutable at the VFS layer. The Lambda function's /tmp is mounted as a separate tmpfs with noexec,nosuid flags.

config.bootstrap_wrapper: Intercepts RIC and applies seccomp filter before handler invocation
